pages.text: Right click a pipe to open its screen. Pick a face, then the Items, Fluids or Energy tab.$(br2)Each extract face has its own settings: enabled state, redstone condition, distribution mode, and the amount to keep in the source or stop at in the target.

Distribution modes: round robin, nearest first, furthest first, random and priority. Priority lets you click targets in the order they should be served.$(br2)Redstone can be ignored, required, or inverted.
